description: This file defines the class BlankMonitor, which extends the Monitor class and implements the Trackable interface. It serves as a placeholder or extension point within the monitoring subsystem of SuiteCRM, providing method stubs for setting and retrieving metrics, saving data, fetching store instances, and clearing metrics. It appears to be part of the module responsible for tracking or monitoring activities within the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: BlankMonitor
classes.description: A class that extends Monitor and implements Trackable, serving as a placeholder tracking monitor with stub methods.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given metric name within the monitor's metrics. Throws an exception if the metric name is not configured.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Returns an array of store names associated with this monitor instance.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns an array of metric instances defined for this monitor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the monitor's data, optionally flushing the metrics.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a store implementation instance by name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the metrics data in the monitor instance.
